title: Highest temperature in London on August 21?
description:
This market will resolve based on the highest temperature recorded in the 'Daily Observations' table on Weather Underground, not the figure displayed in the 'Day High & Low' summary section; in the event of any discrepancy between the two, the Daily Observations table shall be the primary resolution source not the Day High & Low section.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the London City Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 21 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the London City Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/gb/london/EGLC.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

**Latest MetService guidance and ensemble model consensus for Wellington on August 21 point to a daytime maximum of 13–14 °C under building high pressure and a strengthening northerly flow.**  

Clearing skies after morning cloud, combined with mild northerly advection, are expected to lift temperatures above the seasonal average of roughly 13 °C while limiting further warming due to persistent on-shore influences and moderate wind speeds. Official forecasts list a high of 13 °C, yet several GFS and ECMWF runs show brief afternoon peaks reaching 14 °C, explaining the market’s 66.5 % implied probability on 14 °C versus 29.5 % on 13 °C. No major model disagreement or rapid synoptic change is indicated before the observation window closes, keeping outcomes outside 12–15 °C at low probability.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 21 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/cn/zhengzhou/ZHCC.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent forecasts from major meteorological agencies indicate a maximum temperature near 30–31°C for Zhengzhou on August 21, with partly cloudy skies, potential thundery showers, and high humidity limiting afternoon heating. Model consensus from sources like the Met Office and BBC Weather centers on 31°C, while variability in cloud cover, precipitation timing, and light northeasterly winds introduces uncertainty that could push readings to 32°C or cap them at 30°C. In late August, typical seasonal patterns feature moderating influences from regional moisture and instability, keeping extremes rare. Trader sentiment reflects this tight range, with implied probabilities clustered around 30–32°C as new model runs and observational updates approach resolution.
